description: This file implements a PBKDF2 password hasher with configurable parameters, including methods for hashing, verifying, and creating PHC strings, specifically for use within the Mattermost project.

classes.name: PBKDF2
classes.description: A struct implementing password hashing using PBKDF2 with configurable work factor and key length, supporting PHC string serialization and verification.

methods.name: DefaultPBKDF2
methods.description: Returns a default-initialized PBKDF2 hasher with SHA256, work factor 600000, and key length 32.

methods.name: NewPBKDF2
methods.description: Creates a new PBKDF2 hasher with specified work factor and key length.

methods.name: NewPBKDF2FromPHC
methods.description: Creates a PBKDF2 hasher from a parsed PHC string, extracting parameters.

methods.name: hashWithSalt
methods.description: Hashes a password with a given salt using PBKDF2 and returns the base64-encoded hash.

methods.name: Hash
methods.description: Generates a PHC string for a password, including a randomly generated salt.

methods.name: CompareHashAndPassword
methods.description: Verifies a password against a stored PHC hash, ensuring parameters match and hashes are equal.

methods.name: IsPHCValid
methods.description: Checks if a PHC string matches the expected parameters and format for this PBKDF2 implementation.
